declaredIntent.summary: Ingest three supplied independent-reader responses as anonymized, revision-bound evidence and publish only a bounded tri-language comprehension result.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All three required locale receipts are anonymized, schema-valid, and bind the same reviewed revision
A bounded three-reader result does not become a general-population or release-readiness claim

guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The delivered P0 documentation has three independent nontechnical-reader feedback submissions, but the canonical result still says no response has been ingested. The stale active handoff that represented the previous post-delivery study also prevents a new Work Item from starting.
constraints: Record only anonymized pseudonyms and no identifying data.
Bind evidence to the supplied current-main revision and the exact Tokyo answer time.
Keep the result bounded to one independent reader per supported locale; do not claim general-population comprehension, release readiness, or a new release.
Do not use reader feedback to block documentation delivery or PR lifecycle execution.
intent.rationale: A structured, schema-validated record turns useful external feedback into auditable evidence while retaining the protocol's distinction between a bounded sample and broad comprehension proof.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized continuation, anonymized evidence use, the supplied response time, and the complete Work Item lifecycle.
